title: Fixed Four Fan Conoids and Open Crown Vault
description: One complete newly authored static four-fan vault bay. A single continuous finite-thickness roof rises in four corner-centred trumpet-like conoidal fields, each with seven whole visible ribs radiating from a low corner spring and sweeping upward to the adjoining crown seams. Four complete piers have broad spring capitals and grounded feet. A real small square opening passes through the central crown and has its own complete narrow rim; four broad arched sides open onto the shared empty bay. Unlike the spherical sail vault the surface is not one cap centred over the bay, and unlike the groin vault it is not the maximum of two crossed cylindrical roofs. Its corner-centred fan curvature, open crown and fully integrated radial rib layout are authored together, not old vault meshes with added decoration. Four opaque constant untextured stone-look PBR roles, metre-style Z up and centred full horizontal bounds at ground soles, one architectural model zero scenes. Artistic fan-vault-inspired exterior only; not a precise historical reconstruction or construction design. No thrust, equilibrium, load bearing, weather sealing, installation, modular fit, access, building-code or structural safety capability made or verified. No rigging, animation or interaction.
